items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: And that's where Gaino finished playing out with us there.

ctx.x: So I said, well I'll give up this, this parade business and let's stick to my other jobs. I ain't fooling that no more. Yeah. Tell you something I was going to ask you, how George Gaino come into the band. Well George Gaino got into the band by way of Lawrence Morero.
